mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the food remainder with microbes was most worthwhile: it showed what bacteria make from fibre and connected back to the lining cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the inner wall to the muscle wall was fairly predictable from the goal and picture, though it finished the structure.

surprise.text: Bacteria produced both small fatty acids and gas, while some fibre remained unbroken.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary; the pictures or goals gave each pairing a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if another chapter connected body systems in a similarly clear way. The bacteria result made me curious about what else happens to the food remainder.
